snippet.title: Night Plane | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
*NIGHT PLANE IS OUT NOW ON STEAM!* 🎉
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310570/Night_Plane/

Welcome to Plane Airlines™, where your first shift as a flight attendant might just be your last.

Set in 1999, Night Plane is a horror job-sim where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed flight.

Your duties are simple:
🎫 CHECK TICKETS - talk to passengers and decide who gets to board.
👀 SPOT THE DOPPELGÄNGERS - not everyone waiting at the gate is human. Whoever you allow onboard comes with you… so choose carefully.
✈️ WORK THE FLIGHT - serve food and drinks, assist passengers, and provide excellent customer service.

Ready for your first shift?
🎮 Play Night Plane: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310570/Night_Plane/
💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/RsSfDRpJZg
👀 Follow us on X: https://x.com/NightPlaneGame

Thank you for flying with Plane Airlines™.
